positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Digital Media Group working as frontend web developer.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Next.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Worship Leader
positions.description: Worship leader in and over music team at Comforter's Church in Temple, GA.

positions.title: Freelance Developer/ Designer
positions.description:
Designed, developed and maintained websites and branding for clients in the healthcare, entertainment, automotive, construction, government and non-profit sectors.   Built sites and managed content with Joomla and Wordpress, employing Bootstrap for page design and layout.  Designed t-shirt graphics, posters, banners, company logos and other brand collateral. Managed information through MS Access database.  Built and maintained using MyPHPadmin to manipulate SQL tables and queries for data management.
Selected Achievements & Projects: 
•	Built business primarily from referrals due to expertise in managing the full life cycle of the design and development process including client relationship, needs analysis, branding, layout, products, services, SEO, analytics, PPC, and technical deployment. 
•	Starack Music:  Designed and developed database that managed inventory and scheduled over 20 route drivers, delivery routers, and product inventories for this national distribution chain. Created structured reporting of financial results with complex SQL statements. Increased resource utilization led to significant revenue gains and a profitable acquisition.
•	Seismic Productions: Edited, sequenced and streamed video clips for this film production company. 
Technologies & Tools:  SQL, MyPHPadmin, Joomla,  Microsoft Access,  Dreamweaver, Angular.JS, Wordpress, Bootstrap; Adobe InDesign, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop

positions.title: Founder, Lead Singer, Guitarist
positions.description:
Founder of the Christian rock band HouseOfThomas, based out of Atlanta, GA.  HouseOfThomas recorded two CD projects under producer, CR Pendleton.
www.houseofthomasband.com

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Member of a front-end web team with 8 engineers responsible for all development and deployment of a physician directory search web application.  Using the Agile development method with Jira management tools, worked within 3-week sprints to deliver product updates and enhancements. Utilized Git/Stash for all file/repository management.  
•	Presented and demonstrated all project output to product owner for each sprint, successfully meeting all deadlines.   
•	Contributed to the development of a product that generated revenue in the first month of launch and set benchmarks Company-wide for a new income stream.
•	Trained developers on Git/Stash file repository management tools 
Technologies & Tools:  HTML, CSS, Javascript/JQuery, XSL Transform/XML, Git/Stash, Grunt, Jira

positions.title: Consulant
positions.description: Technical Consulting, including project management, web design/ maintenance, database management, and overall document management strategies including variable output reporting, scanning and design.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed and maintained church website.  Website included regular updates of event photos, audio recordings, news headlines, and event announcements as well as mass community communications via newsletters, Facebook and Twitter.  
•	Responsible for hosting of website as well as maintenance of domain names and company (church) email addresses.
•	Designed t-shirt graphics, posters, banners, logos, etc.

positions.title: Senior Services Specialist
positions.description:
Developed and implemented MS Access/VBA database solution to manage the daily workflow of high-volume, integrated print files.  
Developed database reporting structure to report monthly volumes from four departments to Chief Operations Officer.
Designed and developed database solutions through Microsoft Access/Visual Basic for Applications to manage the print and mail processing of client distribution checks totaling over $1 million per day.
Maintained relationship with fourteen vendors specializing in the production, reproduction and distribution of mission critical documents.  
Managed electronic print streams from UNIX and Windows NT platforms using Solimar Print Solutions software.  
Completed quarterly reviews and monitored Developmental Action Plan for one staff assistant.

educations.schoolName: Computer Automated Mechanical Drafting 	Carroll Technical Institute
